label: Quest

intro: This leg of the shamanic trial tasks an initiate with bringing purified water back across the Barrens to Islen Waterseer. Prepared and blessed by the recluse Brine, this vial contains the catalyst required to distill a spiritual sapta. Once brewed, the draught will reveal the elemental spirits dwelling in the distant waters of Silverpine Forest.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Islen will have one more task for you before rewarding you with your next totem. The vial of water I've given you is necessary for whatever that task is.
Go now and find her. We shall meet again some day.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Hello again, friend. You're looking well.
What brings you back to me so soon?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah, a vial of water created and blessed by Brine, and gathered by you, no less.
The liquid in this vial will be key in creating a sapta for you, but also used in one other task.

The sapta I create for you should be used to see the water spirits at the shrine in Silverpine Forest, south of the Undercity. The remaining drops, well, the remaining drops I will tell you about if you feel you are ready.
Are you prepared for one more journey, friend?
